channel.title: Perch
channel.description: Updates for Perch, a tiny floating todo list for the Mac.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
• The first release of Perch.
  • A small panel that floats above your work and fits its list.
  • Return adds a todo below. Arrows move, Shift selects more, and Command-Z undoes anything.
  • Complete, drag to reorder, and delete. Completed todos go to the Archive.
  • Eight themes, four fonts, text size, corner radius, and eight app icons.
  • Control-Option-Space shows the panel from any app.
